sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: A Warrior feature that punishes an adversary leaving Melee range.
When: Use for Garrick when an adversary in Melee tries to leave that range.
Not When: Do not grant it to every PC unless their sheet gives the feature.
Question: Can Garrick stop them leaving?
Answer: If the feature applies, make the reaction roll and choose the listed success effect from the sheet.
Example: Garrick cuts off a skeleton trying to slip past him toward the ritual.
Aliases: opportunity attack leaving melee warrior feature
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
